integrity: Infinite statement proved using projective-plane axioms and an explicit four-round Ehrenfeucht-Fraisse strategy. Finite computations verify sample prime orders but are not used as an infinite proof. Historical priority is checked against accessible sources only.
scientific_limitations: Finite projective planes of order at least two, pure graph equality/adjacency, quantifier rank four. The Fano-versus-higher-order distinguishing depth is five; no complete rank-five spectrum or general incidence-configuration extension is asserted.
title: Forgetting the parts makes every finite projective plane four-round equivalent
